programme.title: Archie Shepp All Star
programme.sub-title: Archie Shepp All Star - Tribute to John Coltrane
programme.desc: In 1960, Archie Shepp attended a concert of John Coltrane at the Five Spot, legendary club of the Lower East Side. Fascinated, he quickly decided to devote himself to the tenor saxophone. Five years later, Shepp - already a staple of free jazz - finally recorded alongside his idol. The result, published in 1966, is called Ascension and still remains today a symbol of free improvisation. At the edge of the fiftieth anniversary of Coltrane's death, gone at forty, the most Parisian of the New York avant-garde celebrates the legacy of the great composer of A Love Supreme with a dazzling French-American all-star who is reminiscent in some respects of the heretic Ascension orchestra. When a giant pays tribute to a god of jazz...

programme.title: Jimmy Smith
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Trombone Shorty
programme.sub-title: Troy 'Trombone Shorty' Andrews: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz phenomenon Trombone Shorty dishes out a mix of funk, jazz, hip-hop and soul at this concert at the French festival Jazz à Vienne. Playing with the energy of a rock star, Troy Andrews, a.k.a. ‘Trombone Shorty', pays homage to jazz legends. With his hypnotic performance and boundless energy, Trombone Shorty puts up an unparalleled performance.

programme.title: Carla Bley, Steve Swallow, Wayne Krantz & Victor Lewis
programme.sub-title: Carla Bley Sextet live at Estival Lugano 1986
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Discover the special bond between pianist Carla Bley and bassist Steve Swallow. The two have performed in the same bands since the '60s and have been romantic partners for more than two decades. Watching them perform is the definition of musical telepathy. Together with musicians Wayne Krantz, Victor Lewis, Larry Willis, and Don Alias, they form an amazing sextet at Estival in 1986.

programme.title: Duke Ellington
programme.sub-title: Duke Ellington: Jazz from Newport, Brussels, 1973
programme.desc: In 1956, Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed a legendary set at the third annual Newport Jazz Festival. It was tenor saxophonist Paul Gonsalves' outstanding 27-chorus solo on “Diminuendo and Crescendo in Blue” that revitalized Ellington's career. The success generated during that performance carried him for the rest of his life. By 1973, festivals carrying the Newport name were organized all over the world. Less than a year before his death, Ellington and his Orchestra, with Gonsalves still in the fold, appeared in Brussels to deliver a timeless performance before a highly appreciative crowd.

programme.title: Junior Mance, Geoff Keezer, Bill Charlap & Alex Wilson
programme.desc: When renowned jazz pianists of the old and new school meet at a "Solo Piano Summit," audiences are treated to many an interesting musical surprise. The "Solo Piano Summit" brings together a handful of top pianists with different musical backgrounds: Jacky Terrasson, Junior Mance, Geoff Keezer, Bill Charlap and Alex Wilson. Besides solo performances the all-stars used the occasion for spontaneous interplay, improvisation and a fantastic finale - in short for the pleasure of virtuoso jazz piano playing.

programme.title: Orquesta Filamonica de Buenos Aires, Carlos Gari, Daniel Barenboim & Mora Godoy
programme.sub-title: A Tango Night - Live from Buenos Aires
programme.desc: 2006 closed with a spectacular festival of Argentinean music broadcast live from Buenos Aires. At the height of the Argentinean summer, the Orquesta Filarmónica del Teatro Colon under Daniel Barenboim (conductor & soloist) join bandoneon virtuoso Leopoldo Federico and his Orquesta Tipica for an extraordinary New Year's Eve show with popular tangos and Latin American orchestra classics. The old master of tango, José Carli, created enchanting new arrangements of works by Argentinean artists Astor Piazzolla, Carlos Gardel, Julio de Caro, Alberto Ginastera and Horacio Salgán. Performances by leading tango dancers Mora Godoy and Junior Cervilla from Buenos Aires add atmosphere and round off the night.

programme.title: Martha Argerich
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Gianandrea Noseda, London Symphony Orchestra, Chris Richards & Rachel Gough
programme.sub-title: Gianandrea Noseda conducts Strauss and Liszt
programme.desc: Gianandrea Noseda conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a concert performance recorded on April 15, 2021, at St. Luke's, London. The program begins with Richard Strauss's Duett-Concertino for clarinet and bassoon, a late, lyrical work that evokes a fairy-tale-like dialogue between the two solo instruments, featuring Chris Richards (clarinet) and Rachel Gough (bassoon). Next is Franz Liszt's Symphonic Poem No. 4, Orpheus, a contemplative and radiant homage to the mythic musician. The concert concludes with Nino Rota's Symphony No. 3, a richly melodic and rhythmically vibrant work that reflects the cinematic flair for which the composer is widely known.

programme.title: Les Dissonances & David Grimal
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Serenade No. 10 for winds in B-flat major, K. 361, also known as the ‘Gran Partita'. The composition is written for twelve winds and double bass and consists of seven parts. The piece's duration is longer than the composer's other chamber music works. Remarkably, Mozart chose to use a larger instrumentation. To the eight instruments of the common wind octet, Mozart added two basset horns, two additional horns, and a double bass. This performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: David Bateson, Tuva Semmingsen, Cassandra Lemoine & Bjørn Fjæstad
programme.sub-title: Fantasymphony – A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with an enchanting concert program. Under the baton of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of The Rings, Game of Thrones, The Hobbit, The Witcher, and League of Legends. Featured soloists in this concert are Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Canadian-Portuguese soprano Cassandra Lemoine, Danish musician Bjørn Fjæstad, and British actor David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in April 2023.

programme.title: Andrea Bacchetti
programme.desc: At the age of eleven, Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti (*1977) debuted with Italian chamber orchestra I Solisti Veneti under the baton of Claudio Scimone. He performed on international festivals and in prestigious concert halls worldwide. Besides, he appeared with several renowned orchestras such as Lucerne Festival Strings, Camerata Salzburg, and Prague Chamber Orchestra. In the current recital, Bacchetti performs J. S. Bach's celebrated Goldberg Variations, BWV 988. Completed in 1741, the work is named after German harpsichordist Johann Gottlieb Goldberg, who might have been the first to have performed the work. Bach's masterpiece consists of an aria and a set of thirty variations. Rather than writing variations on the aria's melody, Bach used the accompanying bass line as his starting point. This performance was recorded at Theater Carlo Felice in Genoa, Italy, on April 13, 2015.

programme.title: Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería & Carlos Miguel Prieto
programme.desc: The Youth Wunderhorn songs are a set of 12 orchestral lieder by Mahler, based on folk poems from the collection by Arnim and Brentano, blending romanticism with folk elements and exploring human experience with authenticity and profound emotional depth. The songs draw from German folk traditions, incorporating themes of nature, love, and soldier life, often with a dramatic or poignant quality.

programme.title: Seal
programme.desc: Seals one-of-a-kind soaring, husky baritone voice is perfect for any genre. Hes delighted fans and earned critical acclaim while staying true to classic, honest songwriting in his remarkable two-decade career. And now, hes done it again with the release of his exceptional sixth studio album Soul. Together with legendary music producer David Foster, Seal adds his signature touch to some of the best soul songs ever created. In a stunning performance, Seal evokes an era when music vividly captured emotion and romance. Joined by Foster, as well as a choir and string section, Seal takes on Ann Pebbles I Cant Stand the Rain, Sam Cookes A Change Is Gonna Come, and Harold Melvin and the Blue Notes If You Dont Know Me By Now. Tune in and catch more timeless favorites and hits like Kiss From a Rose.

programme.title: Michael Bublé
programme.desc: Caught in the Act is the second live album released by Canadian jazz crooner Michael Bublé. It was filmed and recorded at the Wiltern Theater in Los Angeles. The filmed concert was aired on PBS as an episode of Great Performances, and the show was subsequently released on DVD along with the audio CD to create the album package, although the audio disc only featured eight of the songs from the concert. The concert featured a few guest artists, including Laura Pausini, Chris Botti, and with an unexpected comedic banter with Bublé, Josh Groban.

programme.title: Mistaken
programme.desc: (2008) Suspenseful thriller with Lana Parrilla. Destitute divorcee Nellie is at rock bottom when she has her identity stolen. Can a potential lover help her track down the thief and restore her life?

programme.title: A Monster Calls
programme.desc: From the director of THE IMPOSSIBLE and the producers of PAN'S LABRYNTH, A MONSTER CALLS is a searing and fantastical story of one boy's journey to confront the truth.

programme.title: The Vow
programme.desc: Real-life story of a newlywed New Mexico couple, Kim and Krickitt Carpenter, who were struck by tragedy shortly after their marriage. A car crash puts the wife in a coma, where she is cared for by her devoted husband.

programme.title: Father of Invention
programme.desc: Robert Axle (Kevin Spacey of AMERICAN BEAUTY, HORRIBLE BOSSES), an eccentric inventor-turned-egomaniacal-infomercial-guru, loses it all when one of his inventions maims thousands of customers.

programme.title: She's The Man
programme.desc: Viola (Amanda Bynes), disguised as her twin brother, joins the high school boys' soccer team and helps win the big game while unexpectedly falling for Duke (Channing Tatum) the hot star forward.

programme.title: Eat, Drink and Be Married
programme.desc: Jess and Max are ready to call off their wedding due to the overwhelming stress over how out-of-control the planning and everything has become. At their wit's end, they go to see Billie, a beautiful ‘always a bridesmaid' kind-hearted soul who has a non-profit devoted to donating the components of already-paid-for, yet dismantled weddings, to the underserved and people with special needs. However, Max's brother Charlie will stop at nothing to keep Jess and Max together and enlists the help of Billie by enticing her with extra help for her business.

programme.title: The Great Ghost Rescue
programme.desc: Young Humphrey is a ghost with a big problem. He and his family, the Craggyfords, have been ousted from their home and left without a place to haunt. As they search for new haunting grounds they soon discover that they are not alone.

programme.title: A King in New York
programme.desc: A recently-deposed European monarch seeks shelter in New York City, where he becomes an accidental television celebrity and is later wrongly accused of being a Communist.

programme.title: Where Angels Fear to Tread
programme.desc: After a rich Edwardian widow impulsively marries a handsome but poor Tuscan dentist and dies in childbirth, her English in-laws try to gain custody of the baby.

programme.title: Thats What I Am
programme.desc: In 1965, 13 y.o. paperboy Andy's paired up with a geek on a project in the popular junior high teacher's class. Andy learns and grows from it.

programme.title: Bigger
programme.desc: A rags-to-riches biopic of visionary Joe Weider, set in the world of fitness. Brothers Joe & Ben Weider were the architects of muscle.

programme.title: Eaten By Lions
programme.desc: A hilarious and heart-warming story of half brothers Omar and Pete, who embark on a journey from Bradford to Blackpool to find Omar's real Dad.

programme.title: Timeline
programme.desc: Based on the Michael Crichton novel. TIMELINE tells the story of a professor who inadvertently catapults himself back to 14th-century France, in the middle of the 100 Years War.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: As the other rookies hunt for an escaped convict, Swarek lets Andy in on his past undercover exploits.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: The rookie cops duke it out for a cause at “Fite Nite.”

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy trades in her uniform for something more risqué when she goes undercover as a prostitute.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: During a home invasion, Andy is left alone and confronted with a hiding thief who is armed and very volatile.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: A fatal traffic collision reveals a shocking truth, and Andy's romance with Det. Callaghan gets complicated.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: A heat wave has wreaked havoc on the city, multiplied by growing fears of a serial rapist on the loose.

programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: Gambler Jake Green enters into a game with potentially deadly consequences.

programme.title: It's a Boy Girl Thing
programme.desc: It's A Boy Girl Thing is a brilliantly funny romantic comedy about next-door neighbours who live worlds apart. Woody Deane (Zegers) and Nell Bedworth (Armstrong) are life long sworn enemies who wake up one day to find themselves in a very strange place: each others bodies. In their switched identities, each sets out to destroy the other's high school reputation. When they start to succeed they get more than they bargained for. Sometimes falling in love can be an out of body experience.

programme.title: Wild Oats
programme.desc: Everything changes for Eva when she receives a life insurance check accidentally made out for five million dollars instead of the expected fifty thousand dollars. She and her best friend take the money and head out for the adventure of a lifetime.

programme.title: The Way
programme.desc: Martin Sheen plays Tom, an American doctor who comes to France to collect the remains of his adult son who was killed in the Pyrenees in a storm while walking The Camino de Santiago - also known as 'The Way of Saint James'. Driven by his desire to understand his lost son, Tom decides to embark on the historical pilgrimage, leaving his California life behind. Armed only with his son's backpack and guidebook, he begins the 800km historical pilgrimage but soon discovers that he won't be alone on this journey - he meets other pilgrims from around the world, all broken and looking for greater meaning in their lives. From the hardship experienced along "The Way" an unlikely group of misfits are bonded and Tom begins to learn the difference between 'The life we live and the life we choose.'

programme.title: Tomorrow Morning
programme.desc: Tomorrow Morning is the story of one couple seen in two separate timelines, a decade apart. This is a story of life, love, misunderstanding and hope... a universal and timeless tale.

programme.title: All Dogs go to Heaven
programme.desc: A poignant, classic masterpiece animation from acclaimed filmmaker Don Bluth and featuring the voice of Burt Reynolds. A stunning family film about the canine criminal underworld as we follow furry outcast, Charlie, who comes back to earth from heaven and befriends a young orphan who can speak to animals. As their friendship blossoms Charlie learns that friendship is the most heavenly gift of all.

programme.title: Lez Bomb
programme.desc: Lez Bomb is a hilarious and sweet “coming out” comedy in the vein of Meet the Parents from Bobby Farrelly, producer of There's Something about Mary. Lauren, (Writer-Director Jenna Laurenzo) comes home with life changing news. As it turns out, there is no good time to drop the Lez Bomb.

programme.title: A Random Encounter
programme.desc: Starring the charming Meghan Markle (Suits), this whirlwind rom-com proves that finding Prince Charming can be a right royal pain. Sassy Mindy is well and truly immersed in the superficial dating scene, while her best friend Laura is a hopeless romantic. So when she has a chance moment with a stranger in a coffee shop, she is left wondering whether this could blossom into a lifelong romance?

programme.title: Couples Vacation
programme.desc: A brilliantly hilarious "in tents" comedy drama, starring David Arquette, Amy Acker and Academy Award nominee June Squibb. With their marriage on the rocks, Jack and Amanda head off on a glamping trip to "reignite their spark". But when their blissful romantic getaway is hijacked by a pair of hipster honeymooners and a hunky land-owner, they are left in more trouble than before!

programme.title: Resistance
programme.desc: 1944, when the women from a Welsh village find their husbands are missing, they must work with a German platoon to survive.

programme.title: The Forger
programme.desc: A teenager wanders into Carmel, California, where he is soon introduced to the art-forgery community.

programme.title: Where hands touch
programme.desc: In 1944, a 15-year-old girl, daughter of a white German mother and a black African father, meets a member of the Hitler Youth. They become bound by the realization of the horrors being committed around them.

programme.title: Please Stand By
programme.desc: A young autistic woman runs away from her caregiver to boldly go and deliver her 500-page Star Trek script to a writing competition in Hollywood. On an adventure full of laughter and tears, Wendy follows the guiding spirit of Mr. Spock on her journey into the unknown.

programme.title: Love at Lookout Lake
programme.desc: (2025) Romcom with Cait Moira and Jonathan Stoddard. Gossip columnist Sierra is on the trail of a mysterious writer rumoured to be living in her hometown. But will an old flame deliver a plot twist?

programme.title: The Happiness Playbook
programme.desc: (2022) Romcom with Kabby Borders and Tyler Harlow. A journalist goes undercover to expose the truth about a mysterious retreat. But when sparks fly with its owner, will love be the front-page story?

programme.title: Inspiring Love
programme.desc: After a misunderstanding shy artist Isla and confident salesman Mark team up to create a sculpture for Mark's his boss. As Isla spends more time with Mark, will his confidence rub off? (2022)

programme.title: Secrets of Bella Vista
programme.desc: (2022) Uplifting drama starring Rachelle Lefevre. Antiques dealer Tess inherits half of a struggling orchard, discovering a half-sister and family secrets that change her understanding of herself.

programme.title: Little Manhattan
programme.desc: Little Manhattan is a feel-good comedy that's perfect for kids and adults alike. In a city known for excitement, two young friends are about to embark on the greatest adventure of all.

programme.title: The Ex
programme.desc: A slacker is forced to work for his father-in-law after his pregnant wife steps away from her high-paying job.

programme.title: The Boy Downstairs
programme.desc: A writer returning to New York after a two-year stint in London, Diana (Zosia Mamet) is searching for a new residence.

programme.title: Tell Me I Love You
programme.desc: Three musicians pull off a scam to pay for their first album. However their past affairs, sexuality, and concept of "family" disrupt societal conventions. With a hit album on the way and stardom right at their fingertips, they must decide what true love is, and what they each mean to each other.

programme.title: Life or Something Like It
programme.desc: The perfect world of a beautiful Seattle television reporter is shattered by the prediction of her death in seven days.

programme.title: 4 Wedding Planners
programme.desc: When Lily goes home to Hawaii, she wants to help save her family's wedding planning business, even when her ex-boyfriend shows up as a new client.

programme.title: A Good Woman
programme.desc: The seductive Mrs. Erlynne (Helen Hunt) travels to Amalfi, Italy, hoping to win over married aristocrat Robert Windermere. But when Windermere's innocent wife Meg (Scarlett Johansson) hears of the scandal, she plots an elaborate revenge.

programme.title: A Time To Dance
programme.desc: John and Abby may have been the perfect couple, but not anymore. When their daughter surprises them with her engagement, their divorce is put on hold. Will the romance surrounding the wedding be enough to rekindle what they have lost?

programme.title: Modern Persuasion
programme.desc: A sexy, modern telling of Jane Austen's "Persuasion." Wren (Alicia Witt: Orange is the New Black) is a happy, single and self-confessed workaholic who, after rising to the top of the corporate ladder, finds herself coming home to her cat every night.

programme.title: Groomzilla
programme.desc: A woman is surprised and dismayed when her fiance takes the planning of their wedding too seriously.

programme.title: A Royal Surprise
programme.desc: When Riley's boyfriend, Mandla, invites her to South Africa to meet his family, she is shocked to discover that he is a prince. The news puts Riley's trust in Mandla in jeopardy, and he must do what he can to win her love back.

programme.title: Identical Love
programme.desc: After being left at the altar, Dr. Charlotte Hudson needs to escape life at home. She signs up to volunteer at a health clinic in a tropical country. But her plans of escaping are thrown off when she comes across her former fiancé's twin brother, Seth (a dentist), who is also volunteering with the clinic. As they spend time together, Seth falls in love with Charlotte, but she struggles to let go of seeing her fiancé every time she looks at Seth. The island romance will help her break free from the past and love Seth for who he is.

programme.title: Love On Harbor Island
programme.desc: Interior designer Lily returns home to help her Aunt Maggie run her marina-side bed and breakfast when she meets Marcus, a handsome seaplane pilot whose work delivering rescue dogs helps Lily discover that home really is where the heart is.

programme.title: Island of Grace
programme.desc: For Megan, matters of faith are to be hidden from her friends and coworkers. Her social life and the way she wants to live come first. But when she goes on a business trip with two coworkers- the arrogant office crush Mark, and the office nobody, Chris-her plane crashes, and she's forced to reexamine her life. Stranded on an island in a far corner of the world, Megan begins a journey not just of survival, but discovering herself and what really matters.

programme.title: Deadly Secrets by The Lake
programme.desc: Original idea by LMN & Harlequin uncovers Thornwood Heights' murder secrets.

programme.title: Disappearance in Yellowstone
programme.desc: Her daughter has been kidnapped and the police think that Jessie is responsible.

programme.title: Fighting for the Kids
programme.desc: Chilling accounts of children in danger and the people who fought to protect them.

programme.title: Killer Vacation
programme.desc: Jake takes pregnant Lindsey to a resort, where they find his soon to be ex-wife.

programme.title: Fatal Honeymoon
programme.desc: True story: Newlywed dies on honeymoon, husband's guilt investigated.

programme.title: Another Man's Wife
programme.desc: After a tragic car accident, a family gets away to a remote mountain cabin to recover and rebuild their lives. During their vacation, a handsome man befriends them only to get revenge and destroy what is left of their fragile lives.

programme.title: My Terrorized Teen
programme.desc: When her daughter is tormented by high school mean girls, one mother must stop it before it becomes deadly…

programme.title: Pretty Little Stalker
programme.desc: A mother warns her popular son away from a new girlfriend, convinced she is dangerous to both of them.

programme.title: Pure Country 2: The Gift
programme.desc: Three angels bestow the gift of song to a young girl, who must follow a series of rules in order hold on to it during her rise to fame and fortune.

programme.title: Little Black Book
programme.desc: A young woman's life begins to resemble the daytime TV talk show she works for after she is persuaded to snoop through her boyfriend's Palm Pilot and discovers more than she wants to know about his past - and present.

programme.title: Man Of The Year
programme.desc: A political talk show host decides to run for president.

programme.title: Jack And Jill
programme.desc: Jack Sadelstein (Adam Sandler) has his normal tranquil life turned upside down when his twin sister Jill (also Adam Sandler) arrives for visit.

programme.title: Little Black Book
programme.desc: A young woman's life begins to resemble the daytime TV talk show she works for after she is persuaded to snoop through her boyfriend's Palm Pilot and discovers more than she wants to know about his past - and present.

programme.title: Class Rank
programme.desc: CLASS RANK is a funny and touching coming-of-age drama in the vein of Election, Easy A or Legally Blonde, from the director of Glee...

programme.title: As of Yet
programme.desc: Told entirely through video calls and digital diaries, Naomi navigates a problematic roommate and a burgeoning romance all while locked down during the Coronavirus pandemic.

programme.title: Girl Most Likely
programme.desc: Kristen Wiig stars as Imogene, once a promising young New York playwright whose promise has fizzled, thanks to a crisis of confidence. Heavily in denial about being dumped by her society boyfriend, Imogene uses her skill for drama to stage an elaborate fake suicide as an appeal for his sympathy.

programme.title: Poms
programme.desc: POMS is an uplifting comedy about Martha a woman who moves into a retirement community and starts a cheerleading squad with her fellow residents, Sheryl, Olive and Alice, proving that it's never too late to follow your dreams.

programme.title: India Sweets and Spices
programme.desc: When Alia returns home from university, she challenges her parents' elitist lifestyle expensive jewellery, lavish dinner parties, and gossiping aunties. But when she invites the son of a local shopkeeper to her mother's upcoming soiree, family secrets begin to surface.

programme.title: Those Dirty Dogs
programme.desc: Near Fort Apache, Mexican bandits raid a U.S. Army supply column, killing soldiers and kidnapping Miss Adams. To stop the raids, President Grant sends Captain Chadwell, Lieutenant Junger, Sergeant Smith, and bounty hunter Korano. Together, they face outlaw Angelo Sanchez and the mad General Mueller in a dangerous mission.

programme.title: California Passage
programme.desc: Cowboy Movie - A series of reversals bring two desperate people together. When a saloon owner is framed by his partner for a stagecoach robbery, he fights to secure an acquittal.

programme.title: The Glory Guys
programme.desc: What could be worse for two cavalry officers than to battle with native tribes? To battle each other for the same woman.

programme.title: His Name Was Sam Walbash, But They Call Him Amen
programme.desc: A cruel and ruthless bandit kills a tavern owner who had ratted him out to the authorities.

programme.title: North West Frontier
programme.desc: In British India a young prince travels by train across rebel-held territory to safety.

programme.title: Daybreak
programme.desc: Eddie is a man with a secret - his second job is that of public hangman. When he falls into the canal following a fight with a youth over his wife, his body is not found. A thriller with unexpected twists.

programme.title: Swallows and Amazons
programme.desc: "Swallows and Amazons" is the story of a group of children who man two sailing dinghies.

programme.title: Hobson's Choice
programme.desc: Harry is a contented man and has decided that his eldest, Maggie, must stay at home and care for him.

programme.title: The Book of Love
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel are in Milan, Italy to search for Casanova's lost Book of Love.

programme.title: Myth of the Maze
programme.desc: Sydney, Nigel and Claudia visit Athens, Greece to search the Minotaur's maze for the legendary golden twine.

programme.title: Afterlife and Death
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel are in Cairo, Egypt and then Amsterdam. They must beat rival relic hunter Avery Ko to the Pharaoh Thutmose's diamond before it is cut up and sold.

programme.title: Etched in Stone
programme.desc: Sydney, Nigel and Stewie Harper head to Stockholm, Sweden to find the Runestone of King Jann I of Norway.

programme.title: Irish Crown Affair
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel head to Dublin, Ireland in search of the missing crown of the last King of Ireland.

programme.title: A Vanishing Art
programme.desc: Accompanying Max the magician, Sydney and Nigel journey to Atlantic City, New Jersey in search of Hungary's lost and allegedly cursed Royal Scepter.

programme.title: Love Letter
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel go to France to look for the lost wedding vows of Josephine Pontoise and Guy de Bourdin, which would prove their heir is the rightful owner of St. Agnes Sur-Loire.

programme.title: A Good Year
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel travel to France to find the lost stones from Marie Antoinette's Crown.

programme.title: Adrift
programme.desc: Adrift is based on the inspiring true story of two sailors who set out to journey across the ocean from Tahiti to San Diego...

programme.title: Behind The Line
programme.desc: Occupied France, 1940. A Nazi Commander discovers one of his prisoners, Danny (Sam Gittins) is a champion boxer. He forces him to fight for his companies entertainment.

programme.title: The Sentinel
programme.desc: Compromised by his affair with the first lady, a veteran secret service agent is framed as a potential presidential assassin and must rely on a hostile former protégé to flush out the real culprit.

programme.title: Warriors' Gate
programme.desc: American teenager Jack Bronson is magically transported to ancient China, where he must become a hero and rescue a beautiful princess from the clutches of the evil barbarian king.

programme.title: The Mask Of Zorro
programme.desc: A sweeping tale of love and honor, tragedy and triumph set against the Spanish conquest of Mexico, THE MASK OF ZORRO stars Anthony Hopkins and Antonio Banderas. After twenty years as the legendary Zorro, Don Diego (Hopkins) must transform a troubled drifter (Banderas) into the fearless hero he oncewas.

Never before has a date in history been so significant to so many cultures, so many religions, scientists, and governments. 2012 is an epic adventure about a global cataclysm that brings an end to the world and tells of the heroic struggle of the survivors.

programme.title: Gattaca
programme.desc: Ethan Hawke and Uma Thurman star in this futuristic sci-fi thriller about a world where genetic engineering is used to perfect the human species.

programme.title: A Dark Place
programme.desc: When a young boy goes missing in a sleepy backwoods town, a local sanitation truck driver, Donald, plays detective, embarking on a precarious and obsessive investigation.

programme.title: Animal Factory [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Suburbanite Ron (Edward Furlong) is spoiled, young and not overly worried about the marijuana charges leveled against him. But, after being made out to be a drug dealer, he faces a five-year jail sentence in San Quentin State Prison. Physically frail and unaccustomed to his rough surroundings, Ron is primed to fall victim to sexual predators and bullying guards -- that is, until he's befriended by Earl (Willem Dafoe), a veteran inmate who finds meaning in protecting the vulnerable new kid.

programme.title: Life of a King
programme.desc: An ex-felon on a path of redemption defies convention and establishes a Chess Club for inner-city teenagers.

programme.title: The Crush [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Writer Nick Eliot moves to a new city for a magazine job and rents a room in the house of Cliff and Liv Forrester, whose 14-year-old daughter, Adrian, instantly makes her attraction to Nick clear. While Nick romances photographer Amy Maddik at work, he has trouble fending off Adrian's advances. As her obsession with Nick grows, Adrian becomes angry at being rejected and starts attacking his property and friends.

programme.title: Arlington Road [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Widowed when his FBI agent wife is killed by an extremist group, college professor Michael Faraday (Jeff Bridges) becomes obsessed with the culture of these groups -- especially when his new all-American neighbors, Oliver (Tim Robbins) and Cheryl Lang (Joan Cusack), start acting suspiciously. With each twist, the mystery deepens and questions loom whether Faraday is consumed by fear and driven by paranoia, or whether a lethal conspiracy has been born on Arlington Road.

programme.title: Castle Falls [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After decades of neglect, Castle Heights Hospital is packed with dynamite and ready to be demolished. However, no one knows that a gang leader, now in prison, hid $3 million in stolen cash inside the abandoned building. Now, three desperate parties want the money -- and they have exactly 90 minutes to find it and get out alive.

programme.title: American Yakuza 2: Back to Back
programme.desc: The violent impulses of Bob Malone (Michael Rooker), a former Los Angeles policeman forced to leave his job in disgrace, get the better of him during a bank robbery, and he wipes out nearly all the robbers. Meanwhile, Koji (Ryo Ishibashi), a Yakuza killer in town to meet with the local Mafia, turns the tables on a deranged terrorist who threatens to bomb an eatery. Corrupt cops bring Koji in, but he soon escapes from custody -- taking Malone and his daughter, Chelsea (Danielle Harris), hostage.

programme.title: Cover-Up [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A tough ex-U.S. Marine journalist battles against time to save the lives of thousands of innocent people after uncovering a complex terrorist plot.

programme.title: La recette de l'amour
programme.desc: Avec l'aide de son nouveau voisin, une chef découvre que ses affaires peuvent prospérer, avec un peu d'effort et de confiance.

programme.title: La soeur de trop
programme.desc: Les jumelles Reina et Alex voient leur vie bouleversée par leur sœur Trinity, qui a été séparée d'elles à la naissance.

programme.title: La vérité sur ma naissance
programme.desc: Lors de la fête d'anniversaire de 16 ans de Rachel Collins, un meurtre est commis et un tissu de mensonges familiaux est révélé.

programme.title: Le dernier roman de Mary
programme.desc: Une célèbre écrivaine engage une assistante sans savoir que cette dernière est en fait une admiratrice dérangée.

programme.title: The Chase
programme.desc: The escape of Bubber Reeves from prison affects the inhabitants of a small Southern town.

programme.title: The Mating Of Millie
programme.desc: A successful businesswoman must find a husband so she can adopt a young orphan.

programme.title: Shockproof
programme.desc: A romantic triangle ensnares a recently-released killer, her ne'er-do-well boyfriend, and a caring parole offi

programme.title: Labyrinth
programme.desc: Teenage Sarah (Jennifer Connelly) journeys through a maze to recover her baby brother (Toby Froud) from a goblin king (David Bowie).

programme.title: The Dark Crystal
programme.desc: Jen, raised by the noble race called the Mystics, has been told that he is the last survivor of his own race, the Gelflings. He sets out to try to find a shard of the dark crystal, a powerful gem that once provided balance to the universe. After the crystal was broken, the evil Skeksis used sinister means to gain control. Jen believes that he can repair the dark crystal and bring peace back to the world, if he can only find the remaining shard.

programme.title: FernGully ... the Last Rainforest
programme.desc: Crysta is a fairy who lives in FernGully, a rainforest in Australia, and has never seen a human before. In fact, she is told they are extinct. But when a logging company comes near the rainforest, she sees that they do exist, and even accidentally shrinks one of them: a boy named Zak. Now her size, Zak sees the damage that the company does and helps Crysta to stop not only them, but an evil entity named Hexxus, who feeds off pollution.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: A tough cop (Jason Statham) goes after a serial killer who targets police officers.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: And Two If By Sea
programme.desc: The story of iconic professional surfers and identical twins CJ & Damien Hobgood. Their sibling rivalry and struggle to each establish their own identity fueled their careers, but ripped their personal and peripheral relationships apart.

programme.title: Isolated
programme.desc: Five world class surfers travel to New Guinea in search of undiscovered waves, but end up discovering so much more.

programme.title: Jay Phillips Isn't Dead
programme.desc: The artistic and cinematic tale of Jay Phillips, one of Australia's greatest surfing talents.

programme.title: Skywatcher Part I: The Journey Begins

programme.title: James Hemings: Ghost in America's Kitchen
programme.desc: The erasure of America's first master chef, James Hemings, is uncovered.

programme.title: Duality: A Graffiti Story
programme.desc: Graffiti artists rise from tagging to acclaim, shaping culture and landing major brand deals.

programme.title: Massacre Canyon
programme.desc: A man has to lead a wagon train carrying rifles through hostile Indian territory.

programme.title: Mackenna's Gold
programme.desc: A US Marshal is forced to lead a gang of bandits to a hidden valley of gold.

programme.title: A Lawless Street
programme.desc: A lawman moves from town to town in the Colorado Territory, ridding each of its outlaws.

programme.title: The Parson And The Outlaw

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A Chinese man and his son fight prejudice as they try to open a laundry in North Fork.

programme.title: The Rifleman

programme.title: Archie Shepp All Star
programme.sub-title: Archie Shepp All Star - Tribute to John Coltrane
programme.desc: In 1960, Archie Shepp attended a concert of John Coltrane at the Five Spot, legendary club of the Lower East Side. Fascinated, he quickly decided to devote himself to the tenor saxophone. Five years later, Shepp - already a staple of free jazz - finally recorded alongside his idol. The result, published in 1966, is called Ascension and still remains today a symbol of free improvisation. At the edge of the fiftieth anniversary of Coltrane's death, gone at forty, the most Parisian of the New York avant-garde celebrates the legacy of the great composer of A Love Supreme with a dazzling French-American all-star who is reminiscent in some respects of the heretic Ascension orchestra. When a giant pays tribute to a god of jazz...

programme.title: Jimmy Smith
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Trombone Shorty
programme.sub-title: Troy 'Trombone Shorty' Andrews: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz phenomenon Trombone Shorty dishes out a mix of funk, jazz, hip-hop and soul at this concert at the French festival Jazz à Vienne. Playing with the energy of a rock star, Troy Andrews, a.k.a. ‘Trombone Shorty', pays homage to jazz legends. With his hypnotic performance and boundless energy, Trombone Shorty puts up an unparalleled performance.

programme.title: Carla Bley, Steve Swallow, Wayne Krantz & Victor Lewis
programme.sub-title: Carla Bley Sextet live at Estival Lugano 1986
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Discover the special bond between pianist Carla Bley and bassist Steve Swallow. The two have performed in the same bands since the '60s and have been romantic partners for more than two decades. Watching them perform is the definition of musical telepathy. Together with musicians Wayne Krantz, Victor Lewis, Larry Willis, and Don Alias, they form an amazing sextet at Estival in 1986.

programme.title: Duke Ellington
programme.sub-title: Duke Ellington: Jazz from Newport, Brussels, 1973
programme.desc: In 1956, Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed a legendary set at the third annual Newport Jazz Festival. It was tenor saxophonist Paul Gonsalves' outstanding 27-chorus solo on “Diminuendo and Crescendo in Blue” that revitalized Ellington's career. The success generated during that performance carried him for the rest of his life. By 1973, festivals carrying the Newport name were organized all over the world. Less than a year before his death, Ellington and his Orchestra, with Gonsalves still in the fold, appeared in Brussels to deliver a timeless performance before a highly appreciative crowd.

programme.title: Junior Mance, Geoff Keezer, Bill Charlap & Alex Wilson
programme.desc: When renowned jazz pianists of the old and new school meet at a "Solo Piano Summit," audiences are treated to many an interesting musical surprise. The "Solo Piano Summit" brings together a handful of top pianists with different musical backgrounds: Jacky Terrasson, Junior Mance, Geoff Keezer, Bill Charlap and Alex Wilson. Besides solo performances the all-stars used the occasion for spontaneous interplay, improvisation and a fantastic finale - in short for the pleasure of virtuoso jazz piano playing.

programme.title: Orquesta Filamonica de Buenos Aires, Carlos Gari, Daniel Barenboim & Mora Godoy
programme.sub-title: A Tango Night - Live from Buenos Aires
programme.desc: 2006 closed with a spectacular festival of Argentinean music broadcast live from Buenos Aires. At the height of the Argentinean summer, the Orquesta Filarmónica del Teatro Colon under Daniel Barenboim (conductor & soloist) join bandoneon virtuoso Leopoldo Federico and his Orquesta Tipica for an extraordinary New Year's Eve show with popular tangos and Latin American orchestra classics. The old master of tango, José Carli, created enchanting new arrangements of works by Argentinean artists Astor Piazzolla, Carlos Gardel, Julio de Caro, Alberto Ginastera and Horacio Salgán. Performances by leading tango dancers Mora Godoy and Junior Cervilla from Buenos Aires add atmosphere and round off the night.

programme.title: Gianandrea Noseda, London Symphony Orchestra, Chris Richards & Rachel Gough
programme.sub-title: Gianandrea Noseda conducts Strauss and Liszt
programme.desc: Gianandrea Noseda conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a concert performance recorded on April 15, 2021, at St. Luke's, London. The program begins with Richard Strauss's Duett-Concertino for clarinet and bassoon, a late, lyrical work that evokes a fairy-tale-like dialogue between the two solo instruments, featuring Chris Richards (clarinet) and Rachel Gough (bassoon). Next is Franz Liszt's Symphonic Poem No. 4, Orpheus, a contemplative and radiant homage to the mythic musician. The concert concludes with Nino Rota's Symphony No. 3, a richly melodic and rhythmically vibrant work that reflects the cinematic flair for which the composer is widely known.

programme.title: Les Dissonances & David Grimal
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Serenade No. 10 for winds in B-flat major, K. 361, also known as the ‘Gran Partita'. The composition is written for twelve winds and double bass and consists of seven parts. The piece's duration is longer than the composer's other chamber music works. Remarkably, Mozart chose to use a larger instrumentation. To the eight instruments of the common wind octet, Mozart added two basset horns, two additional horns, and a double bass. This performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: David Bateson, Tuva Semmingsen, Cassandra Lemoine & Bjørn Fjæstad
programme.sub-title: Fantasymphony – A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with an enchanting concert program. Under the baton of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of The Rings, Game of Thrones, The Hobbit, The Witcher, and League of Legends. Featured soloists in this concert are Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Canadian-Portuguese soprano Cassandra Lemoine, Danish musician Bjørn Fjæstad, and British actor David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in April 2023.

programme.title: Andrea Bacchetti
programme.desc: At the age of eleven, Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti (*1977) debuted with Italian chamber orchestra I Solisti Veneti under the baton of Claudio Scimone. He performed on international festivals and in prestigious concert halls worldwide. Besides, he appeared with several renowned orchestras such as Lucerne Festival Strings, Camerata Salzburg, and Prague Chamber Orchestra. In the current recital, Bacchetti performs J. S. Bach's celebrated Goldberg Variations, BWV 988. Completed in 1741, the work is named after German harpsichordist Johann Gottlieb Goldberg, who might have been the first to have performed the work. Bach's masterpiece consists of an aria and a set of thirty variations. Rather than writing variations on the aria's melody, Bach used the accompanying bass line as his starting point. This performance was recorded at Theater Carlo Felice in Genoa, Italy, on April 13, 2015.

programme.title: Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería & Carlos Miguel Prieto
programme.desc: The Youth Wunderhorn songs are a set of 12 orchestral lieder by Mahler, based on folk poems from the collection by Arnim and Brentano, blending romanticism with folk elements and exploring human experience with authenticity and profound emotional depth. The songs draw from German folk traditions, incorporating themes of nature, love, and soldier life, often with a dramatic or poignant quality.

programme.title: Lana Del Rey
programme.desc: Born to Die is the second album by singer-songwriter Lana Del Rey, and the first to be officially released on January 27, 2012 and that would lead to global success In countries such as the United Kingdom the album was the best selling of that year, that recognition made her a guest of honor in one of the most popular London festivals iTunes Festival, where she would open the awe of all attendees on the night of September 25 2012 at the Roundhouse in the city of London.

programme.title: Seal
programme.desc: Seals one-of-a-kind soaring, husky baritone voice is perfect for any genre. Hes delighted fans and earned critical acclaim while staying true to classic, honest songwriting in his remarkable two-decade career. And now, hes done it again with the release of his exceptional sixth studio album Soul. Together with legendary music producer David Foster, Seal adds his signature touch to some of the best soul songs ever created. In a stunning performance, Seal evokes an era when music vividly captured emotion and romance. Joined by Foster, as well as a choir and string section, Seal takes on Ann Pebbles I Cant Stand the Rain, Sam Cookes A Change Is Gonna Come, and Harold Melvin and the Blue Notes If You Dont Know Me By Now. Tune in and catch more timeless favorites and hits like Kiss From a Rose.

programme.title: Michael Bublé
programme.desc: Caught in the Act is the second live album released by Canadian jazz crooner Michael Bublé. It was filmed and recorded at the Wiltern Theater in Los Angeles. The filmed concert was aired on PBS as an episode of Great Performances, and the show was subsequently released on DVD along with the audio CD to create the album package, although the audio disc only featured eight of the songs from the concert. The concert featured a few guest artists, including Laura Pausini, Chris Botti, and with an unexpected comedic banter with Bublé, Josh Groban.

Una divertida comedia que aborda la posibilidad científica de la clonación y el desastre que puede generar.

programme.title: 500 $, vivo o muerto

programme.title: El jardín del diablo
programme.desc: Tres americanos navegan alrededor del cabo hasta los yacimientos de oro de California cuando son puestos en tierra durante varias semanas en un pequeño pueblo mexicano dormido.

programme.title: V.I.P.: La otra casa
programme.desc: Rodada en una de las prisiones mas peligrosas de Guatemala, VIP cuenta la historia de Juan Ramos, Sub – Contralor General de la Nación, quien es arrestado e ingresado a prisión preventiva, mientras prueba su inocencia por cargos de corrupción y asesinato. Aunque ha pagado por estar en el sector VIP, es llevado al peor sector de la cárcel. Su lucha por llegar a ser parte del sector exclusivo, lo hará conocer la cruda realidad vivida día a día dentro de la prisión. Pero desde el VIP, sus enemigos cocinan planes vengativos con el fin de hacer la estadía de Juan lo mas corta y violenta posible.

programme.title: Voces secretas
programme.desc: La criminóloga Marta Colombo investiga el asesinato de un conocido y odiado empresario. Hay varios sospechosos y nadie sabe si saldrá la verdad a la luz o si se hará justicia.

programme.title: Mañana, cuando la guerra empiece
programme.desc: Cuando su país es invadido y sus familias secuestradas, ocho adolescentes se unen para luchar.

programme.title: Amor de ida y vuelta

Cuando la joven decide poner fin a la relación, Stillman construirá una máquina del tiempo que le lleve de vuelta al pasado para arreglar las cosas... pero la reconciliación no sale a la primera... ni a la segunda... y como ya pasaba en “El día de la marmota”, Stillman se verá abocado a repetir una y otra vez el mismo día intentando ser una persona mejor y que Debbie no le deje. Para ello contará con la ayuda de su amigo Evan.

programme.title: Testigo virtual

Al querer llamar a la policía se dá cuenta de que no tiene ni su nombre ni su dirección a pesar de llevar varios meses chateando con ella. Thomas se ve implicado en la investigación que realiza Claire, una joven especialista de la delincuencia informática. Las indagaciones les conducen hasta el hermano de Thomas que al parecer tiene relación con una organización criminal que actúa en directo por Internet. Pero a Claire le retiran el asunto de la noche a la mañana. Entonces, ella y Thomas deciden colocar una trampa con la que esperan revelar toda la verdad.

Finalmente ellos también son testigos de extraños fenómenos que tienen lugar alrededor de la casa y que van aportando pistas de lo que podría ser un escalofriante misterio que se ha mantenido en secreto durante generaciones.

programme.desc: Dos chicos de instituto que no consiguen ligar son víctimas de una broma de dos chicas.

programme.desc: Mientras un hombre conduce su moto por el desierto, unos matones le roban el vehículo y lo dan por muerto. Sobrevive y ya no piensa en el suicidio, porque ahora tiene un objetivo en la vida: vengarse y recuperar su moto.

programme.title: Cambio mortal
programme.desc: David Terran, un brillante científico, ha perdido su credibilidad a causa de sus teorías apocalípticas. Las explosiones nucleares en Irán tendrán graves repercusiones y la comunidad científica tendrá que confiar en David.

programme.title: County Line
programme.desc: Cuando el mejor amigo del ex sheriff Alden Rockwell es tiroteado, éste se ofrece como investigador privado para averiguar la verdad tras el tiroteo y descubre una conspiración criminal entre dos condados.

programme.title: Behewulf: la Leyenda Vikinga
programme.desc: Dinamarca, siglo VI. El rey danés Hrothgar y sus guerreros matan a un trol cuyo hijo, Grendel, jura vengarse.

programme.title: La particula de Dios
programme.desc: El detective privado Ned Cruz recibe el encargo de encontrar a Lexi Persimmon, una stripper que ha desaparecido junto a un alijo de diamantes valorado en 30 millones de dólares. Cruz topará con personajes oscuros, algunos morirán misteriosamente, otros tienen entre manos planes siniestros.

programme.title: El hombre del presidente II
programme.desc: Joshua McCord, veterano de las fuerzas especiales y guardaespaldas del presidente de los Estados Unidos, recibe una importante misión confiada directamente por el presidente.

programme.title: Comando War Pigs
programme.desc: Al Capitán de la Segunda Guerra Mundial Jack Wosick, se le da la oportunidad de redimirse cuando se le designa para dirigir una unidad variopinta de soldados inadaptados conocidos como los “War Pigs”.

programme.title: Michel Vaillant
programme.desc: "24 horas al límite" basada en el comic francés "Michel Valliant", es un proyecto de Luc Besson que pretende aunar las pasiones del cine, rallyes y carreras y suscitarla las emociones más fuertes.

programme.title: Hurricane
programme.desc: Pilotos polacos luchan en la Batalla de Inglaterra.

programme.title: El hombre del presidente II
programme.desc: Un especialista antiterrorista encargado de localizar a un terrorista.

programme.title: Transmorphers
programme.desc: Una raza de robots alienígenas ha conquistado la Tierra.

programme.title: Treasure Hunters
programme.desc: Dos equipos de buscadores de tesoros realizan una excavación ilegal en la isla de Corregidor, Filipinas.

programme.title: Los Angeles De Charlie Al Limite
programme.desc: Las tres agentes están de vuelta Los ángeles están dispuestas a dar guerra para recuperar una información encriptada en dos anillos, que revela las identidades de todas las personas acogidas al programa de protección de testigos. Cuando éstos empiezan a morir, sólo las intrépidas chicas podrán detener al responsable, usando su experiencia en el camuflaje, espionaje y artes marciales. Además se las tendrán que ver con un ángel caído -Demi Moore-.

programme.title: Misteriosa Obsesion
programme.desc: Sam Paretta, de nueve años murió en un accidente aéreo. Aunque han pasado 14 meses desde el accidente, su madre Telly (Julianne Moore, "Far From Heaven"), todavía llora su muerte. Pero de repente, su marido (Anthony Edwards, "ER") jura que nunca tuvieron un hijo y su psiquiatra (Gary Sinise, "C.S.I.: NY") insiste en que sufre delirios. Pero lo peor de todo es no hay ninguna evidencia para probar que Sam haya existido alguna vez. Obsesionada por los recuerdos de su hijo, la búsqueda por la verdad embarca a Telly en una oscura y devastadora conspiración de terror sobrenatural.

programme.title: 21: Blackjack
programme.desc: Crónica de las andanzas de un grupo de jóvenes expertos en triunfar en los casinos. Ben Campbell, un tímido y brillante estudiante del prestigioso Instituto Tecnológico de Massachussets (MIT), recurre a los naipes para poder pagar la matrícula de la universidad.
